articles.title: Spacecraft Returns to the Scene of a Cosmic Crash
articles.summary: ESA's Hera spacecraft has arrived at the asteroid Dimorphos to study the crash NASA's Dart spacecraft caused in 2022, the first test of Earth's planetary defences.

articles.title: Is This El Niño a 'Mega' One? Scientists Say Not So Fast
articles.summary: Nicknames for this year's El Niño keep getting bigger, from Super to Godzilla to Mega, but scientists say NOAA's top category is still simply very strong.

articles.title: Huawei Found Guilty of Stealing Trade Secrets
articles.summary: A Brooklyn jury found Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets and bank fraud, but cleared it of the most serious racketeering charge.
